definitions.explanation: A circular chart divided into sectors to show proportions of a whole. A fundamental type of data visualization used in education, business, and media.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{円|えん}グラフ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧。
examples.english: Show the results in a pie chart.

examples.japanese: {円|えん}グラフ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{食費|しょくひ}→食費：16477_shokuhi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Looking at the pie chart, food expenses make up the largest proportion.

examples.japanese: ⟦プレゼンテーション→プレゼンテーション：29053_purezenteeshon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧{構成比|こうせいひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{円|えん}グラフにして⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: In the presentation, I explained the sales breakdown using a pie chart.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (circle) + ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧ (graph, from English). One of the basic chart types taught in Japanese schools and widely used in business presentations and news media.
